project_meta.title: This Too Shall Pass
project_meta.inspiration: Elder brother's enduring wisdom during moments of overwhelm

style_bible.visual_prefix: Cinematic 35mm film still, Kodak Portra 400 color grading, shallow depth of field, natural atmospheric lighting, photorealistic, high emotional realism, 16:9 aspect ratio --no text, watermarks, distorted hands
style_bible.character_anchor: An East African young adult in their late 20s wearing a dark textured knit sweater, thoughtful expression
style_bible.audio_tone: Warm, unhurried, intimate spoken-word narration with soft ambient rain transitioning into gentle morning acoustic resonance

scenes.title: The Weight
scenes.narration: There are nights when the weight of everything unfinished feels permanent.
scenes.visual_prompt: An East African young adult in their late 20s wearing a dark textured knit sweater, sitting at a cluttered wooden desk late at night, illuminated only by a warm desk lamp, rain streaks on a dark window behind them, exhausted posture, head resting in one hand.
scenes.subtitle_text: There are nights when the weight of everything unfinished feels permanent.

scenes.title: The Anchor
scenes.narration: That is when I hear my older brother's voice—steady, unshaken, reminding me.
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up on a weathered cream-colored notebook on a wooden desk, a fountain pen resting beside a handwritten note, soft warm tungsten lamp glow highlighting paper grain and dust motes in the air.
scenes.subtitle_text: That is when I hear my older brother's voice—steady, unshaken, reminding me.

scenes.title: The Passage
scenes.narration: No storm owns the sky forever. Even the heaviest hour moves.
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic landscape of misty Ethiopian highland hills at the break of dawn, heavy dark rain clouds parting as golden morning sunbeams pierce through the valley below, atmospheric mist.
scenes.subtitle_text: No storm owns the sky forever. Even the heaviest hour moves.

scenes.title: The Shift
scenes.narration: You do not have to solve the whole road tonight. Just breathe, and take the next step.
scenes.visual_prompt: Morning golden sunlight streaming through a clean window onto a tidy wooden desk, an East African young adult in their late 20s wearing a dark textured knit sweater standing calmly by the window holding a warm ceramic mug, peaceful expression.
scenes.subtitle_text: You do not have to solve the whole road tonight. Just breathe, and take the next step.

scenes.title: The Echo
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist sunlit wooden tabletop with warm morning shadows of windowpanes cast across the grain, a single small green plant leaf catching golden light, tranquil stillness.
